title: Warm Wholesome Argentinian Oreo Bowl
description: This dish is an earthy and flaky Argentinian treat featuring Oreo cream biscuits and a sweet glaze, served in a Korean brass bowl. It is ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly and perfect for a sweet snack.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix together the crushed Oreo cream biscuits, chopped nuts, and shredded coconut in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the dulce de leche, coconut milk, honey, cinnamon, and vanilla extract.
Pour the wet ingredients over the dry ingredients and stir until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a Korean brass bowl and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Drizzle the top with additional dulce de leche and honey if desired.
